newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S-E-Banken not spending time on partner.
newsitem.headline: S-E-Banken not spending time on partner.

text.p: Swedish commercial bank S-E-Banken's chief executive Bjorn Svedberg said on Friday that the bank was not spending any time seeking a partner.
A proposed merger with state-controlled Nordbanken fell through earlier this month with the two banks saying negotiations had ended with no conclusion.
"We are not devoting any time to finding a partner," Svedberg told a news conference after the bank posted its 1996 earnings.
"We have no need of any quick merger."

Last September it was rumoured that S-E-Banken was interested in merging with Handelsbanken but this speculation bit the dust when Handelsbanken made a cash takeover bid for mortgage bank Stadshypotek.
S-E-Banken earlier on Friday reported a better-than-expected 68 percent leap in operating profit for 1996 to 5.87 billion crowns.
